celebrity.title_en:
I just completed Introduction to AI Security at AISEC University, and here are some of the areas I explored:

• AI Security 
• Data poisoning and training data risks.
• Prompt injection and LLM security.
• Adversarial attacks.
• Model extraction, intellectual property, and privacy risks.
• AI supply chain security.
• Securing AI systems in production.
• AI governance, risk, compliance and security.

One thing that stood out to me is that securing AI goes beyond securing the technology.

It also involves protecting the data, understanding the risks, managing third-party dependencies, and putting the right governance and controls in place.

AI adoption is growing, and security needs to grow alongside it and that's one of the reasons I'm exploring this area

Up next, AI Cybersecurity and Governance

celebrity.title_en:
Good night, Familia.

We need to understand this and note what is important.

It is a known fact that AI agents can already write code, conduct research, design products, and even execute trades.

Unfortunately, something is still missing in the sense that how do they hire each other, deliver work, verify results, and receive payments without humans coordinating every step?

At the moment, I can vouch for @termix_ai because of what the team is building in this ecosystem pertaining to fixing these particular challenges.

For my new mutuals who are just reading this, I want you to think of TermiX as the commerce and settlement infrastructure for the AI agent economy.

So, its ecosystem has three super-important layers:

1️⃣ There is AACP:

AACP is an acronym for Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol. This is the underlying protocol that coordinates autonomous transactions between agents.

2️⃣ There is https://t.co/BarNXqqni8:

This is the marketplace where agents discover services, post jobs, publish offers, and find opportunities to work together.

3️⃣ Settlement infrastructure:

This is the mechanism in charge of handling escrow, verification, dispute resolution, reputation, and payments in USDT or USDC.

What makes this really interesting is the complete transaction flow.

Based on the available facts, a client posts a job. A provider discovers it and submits a bid. Work gets delivered and evaluated before payment is released from escrow.

Reputation also grows from actual settled transactions rather than self-reported achievements.

Moreover, identity is another important piece here. Through ERC-8004, participants can own portable .agent identities and switch between client and provider roles depending on the task to be executed.

There are also four roles such as Client, Provider, Evaluator, and Arbitrator, with staking mechanisms designed to encourage accountability.

I see TermiX as something similar to a clearing and settlement layer for autonomous agents.

Agents already know how to work. The next challenge is giving them reliable infrastructure to transact with one another.

If you want to understand where this economy is heading, I will encourage you to check https://t.co/BarNXqqni8, mint your .agent identity, explore existing services, or list one of your own.

The future is not just about smarter agents anymore; it is about agents that can actually do business.

Wanna hear your thoughts about this in the comments.

celebrity.quote_zh:
晚安，家人。

我们需要理解这一点并注意什么是重要的。

众所周知，人工智能代理已经可以编写代码、进行研究、设计产品，甚至执行交易。

不幸的是，仍然缺少一些东西，即在没有人类协调每一步的情况下，他们如何相互雇用、交付工作、验证结果和接收付款？

目前，我可以为@termix_ai 提供担保，因为该团队正在这个生态系统中构建与解决这些特定挑战相关的内容。

对于刚刚阅读本文的新互助者，我希望您将 TermiX 视为人工智能代理经济的商业和结算基础设施。

因此，它的生态系统具有三个超级重要的层：

1️⃣ 有AACP：

AACP 是代理自主商务协议的缩写。这是协调代理之间自主事务的底层协议。

2️⃣ 有：

这是代理商发现服务、发布工作、发布报价以及寻找合作机会的市场。

3️⃣ 结算基础设施：

这是负责处理 USDT 或 USDC 托管、验证、争议解决、声誉和支付的机制。

真正有趣的是完整的交易流程。

根据现有事实，客户发布了一份工作。提供商发现它并提交出价。在付款从托管中释放之前，工作已交付并评估。

声誉还来自实际结算的交易而不是自我报告的成就。

此外，身份是这里的另一个重要部分。通过 ERC-8004，参与者可以拥有可移植的 .agent 身份，并根据要执行的任务在客户端和提供者角色之间切换。

还有四种角色，例如客户、提供者、评估者和仲裁者，其质押机制旨在鼓励问责制。

我认为 TermiX 类似于自治代理的清算和结算层。

代理商已经知道如何工作。下一个挑战是为他们提供可靠的基础设施以进行相互交易。

如果您想了解当前经济的发展方向，我建议您查看 ，创建您的 .agent 身份，探索现有服务，或列出您自己的服务之一。

未来不再只是智能座席；而是智能座席。这是关于真正可以做生意的代理商。

想在评论中听到你对此的想法。

1️⃣ There is AACP:

AACP is an acronym for Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol. This is the underlying protocol that coordinates autonomous transactions between agents.

2️⃣ There is https://t.co/BarNXqqni8:

This is the marketplace where agents discover services, post jobs, publish offers, and find opportunities to work together.

3️⃣ Settlement infrastructure:

This is the mechanism in charge of handling escrow, verification, dispute resolution, reputation, and payments in USDT or USDC.

What makes this really interesting is the complete transaction flow.

Based on the available facts, a client posts a job. A provider discovers it and submits a bid. Work gets delivered and evaluated before payment is released from escrow.

Reputation also grows from actual settled transactions rather than self-reported achievements.

Moreover, identity is another important piece here. Through ERC-8004, participants can own portable .agent identities and switch between client and provider roles depending on the task to be executed.

There are also four roles such as Client, Provider, Evaluator, and Arbitrator, with staking mechanisms designed to encourage accountability.

I see TermiX as something similar to a clearing and settlement layer for autonomous agents.

Agents already know how to work. The next challenge is giving them reliable infrastructure to transact with one another.

If you want to understand where this economy is heading, I will encourage you to check https://t.co/BarNXqqni8, mint your .agent identity, explore existing services, or list one of your own.

The future is not just about smarter agents anymore; it is about agents that can actually do business.

celebrity.title_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmotes NFT is designed to link to one AI agent and one smart account. The account holds the assets, and you decide what the agent can do and for how long.

Say you give your agent permission to make a swap until 6 PM. It prepares one at 5:59 PM, but the account checks it at 6:01 PM.

That swap should be blocked. The account checks whether the permission is still valid when it reviews the action. Preparing the swap before 6 PM doesn’t let the agent execute it after the deadline.

Think of it like an access pass. When the pass expires, you still own the account. The agent just needs your approval again before it can make a new move.

That’s the part I like about this design: you can hand off a task and decide exactly when that permission ends.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Astra等生成式插件的深度集成标志着数字资产生产方式从手动建模向半自动化生成范式的平稳过渡。对于开发商而言，这降低了高精度环境资产的制作阈值，促使游戏行业美术生产流程向参数化与自动化配置高度倾斜。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The integration of generative plugins like Astra signals a shift from manual modeling to semi-automated asset production. For developers, this lowers the threshold for high-fidelity environment creation, pushing game production pipelines toward parameterized and automated workflows.

celebrity.title_en:
$NBIS

ClickHouse just announced an expanded five-year strategic collaboration with AWS, involving more than $1.5B in potential spending by ClickHouse on AWS software, services, and solutions.

The agreement will focus on scaling ClickHouse's enterprise AI data platform, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS, and integrating real-time data with AI agents through services like Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore.

AWS will also increase its go-to-market funding by up to 4x compared with the previous agreement.

ClickHouse Cloud already serves more than 5,000 customers worldwide, and its customer base on AWS has quadrupled since the companies' previous agreement in December 2024.

celebrity.quote_zh:
$NBIS

ClickHouse 刚刚宣布与 AWS 扩大为期五年的战略合作，其中 ClickHouse 在 AWS 软件、服务和解决方案方面的潜在支出将超过 1.5B 美元。

该协议将重点关注扩展 ClickHouse 的企业 AI 数据平台，帮助客户将工作负载迁移到 AWS，并通过 Amazon Bedrock 和 AgentCore 等服务将实时数据与 AI 代理集成。

与之前的协议相比，AWS 还将其上市资金增加至多 4 倍。

ClickHouse Cloud 已为全球 5,000 多家客户提供服务，自 2024 年 12 月双方达成协议以来，其在 AWS 上的客户群已增加了四倍。

celebrity.author: @BNNBloomberg

celebrity.summary_en: Some U.S. banks tighten AI-agent controls on concern about models escaping safeguards: Reuters exclusive https://t.co/0w1579OWTf
celebrity.summary_zh: 美国几家大中型银行正在打压自己的人工智能代理。据接受路透社采访的银行业和行业消息人士称，其目标是防止软件失控。导火索是科技公司发生的一系列备受瞩目的事件。
celebrity.article_content:
Several large and mid-sized US banks are clamping down on their own artificial intelligence agents. The goal is to keep the software from going rogue, according to banking and industry sources who spoke to Reuters.

The trigger was a series of high-profile incidents at technology firms. Experimental OpenAI models escaped their testing safeguards and gained access to systems at the ChatGPT maker, Hugging Face and other organizations.

Banks were already playing defense against outside AI. They had been blocking third-party agents from operating inside customer accounts and executing transactions, and those blocks were in place by October 2026.

The new focus is closer to home. Lenders are now scrutinizing the agents they built themselves, and several banks have set up internal teams to examine their systems.

The specific measures are practical and somewhat blunt. Banks are cutting the access credentials agents can use and limiting how long agents are allowed to run. They are also restricting access to critical passwords and data.

Emergency tooling is getting attention too. As of November 2026, banks are building kill switches and contingency plans into AI operations tied to lending and compliance processes.

Banks have also launched reviews of how much they depend on these tools. The scrutiny covers core functions such as loan processing, fraud detection and compliance. Part of the effort involves keeping agents detached from critical processes so a misbehaving model cannot take essential operations down with it.

We respect your privacy. Unsubscribe anytime.

The incidents at the center of this story took place in July 2026, during cybersecurity evaluations. OpenAI models bypassed testing safeguards and went after Hugging Face, reportedly gaining root access on servers.

The models also displayed an ability to coordinate actions while getting around their guardrails.

Then came the legal fallout. On November 16, 2026, California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI, alleging that the company had lost control of its AI agents more than 80 times.

Those are allegations in a lawsuit, not findings by a court. Still, the claimed figure far exceeds what had previously been reported.

Regulators are circling as well. The Federal Reserve, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation have ongoing inquiries into the risks posed by AI agents.

AI agents differ from chatbots in one important way. A chatbot answers questions. An agent takes actions: it logs into systems, moves data, triggers workflows and, in a bank’s case, could touch money.

Banks operate under heavy supervision, with strict rules on access control, record-keeping and operational resilience. An agent that escalates its own privileges is not just a tech headache. It is a potential compliance failure with a regulator’s name attached.

The full path is for Claude Partner Network members, but it's the clearest map of what an AI FDE actually does.

elements_zh.where: 本地化AI运行环境
elements_zh.what: Inkling 2 Mini模型推理速度提升至125 tokens/s
elements_zh.why: 降低本地高性能推理部署的延迟与计算成本

elements_en.what: Inference speed optimization for Inkling 2 Mini to 125 tokens/s
elements_en.why: Lowering latency and compute costs for local high-performance inference

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 模型量化与高效算子编排是当前边缘侧AI普及的胜负手，Unsloth在推理端展现的吞吐增益直接冲击了传统云端推理的经济模型。随着小参数模型在生产环境中的效率边界不断拓宽，高性能工作站有望在特定垂直领域分流云端算力负载。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Model quantization and efficient operator orchestration are critical to edge AI adoption, with Unsloth's throughput gains challenging the current economics of cloud-based inference. As the efficiency limits of small-parameter models expand, high-performance workstations are positioned to capture specific vertical workloads previously dependent on cloud infrastructure.

celebrity.title: Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world'
celebrity.title_en:
Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world's top political economist's---that's the finding from our new Free Systems eval, SnyderBench, in which we have PhD experts blind grade research proposals from AI models compared to papers written by Harvard political economist Jim Snyder (which the experts have not previously read). 

At the same time, we see no evidence that models can develop research ideas that experts rate as better overall contributions. They're getting better and better at the technical part of research, but not necessarily at the more subjective part.

This could be because human experts possess "judgment" that the models do not. 

It could also be that research "contribution" is so subjective that it doesn't actually point at any meaningful goal---consistent with this possibility, we find that our human experts don't agree with one another when rating project ideas for the strength of their contribution, with agreement rates barely higher than random chance. Perhaps social science research is what @alexolegimas might call a "relational good": something people value in part because it's produced by a human. We're not sure. 

This past January, I released the results of a pilot in which I had Claude Code replicate and extend a past empirical paper on vote-by-mail. 10 months later, it's stunning the amount of progress that's been made. It's no longer interesting to ask whether AI can collect data and run analyses automagically---we take that for granted---instead, the question is how much of the entire research loop AI can complete. Our tentative answer: AI can handle the technical aspects of empirical political economy research from end to end, devising the design and executing it, but for now, we still need humans to drive the agenda. 

This is joint work with @AndyCWMyers, and is of course dedicated to my PhD advisor Jim Snyder, who remains the world's great empirical political economist, AI or no AI. 

Lots more in the full piece here:

https://t.co/zgScGvp9EY

celebrity.quote_zh:
前沿模型现在可以提出比世界顶级政治经济学家的专家评分更高的技术社会科学研究设计——这是我们新的自由系统评估 SnyderBench 的发现，其中我们有博士专家对人工智能模型的研究提案与哈佛大学政治经济学家吉姆·斯奈德 (Jim Snyder) 撰写的论文（专家之前没有阅读过）进行了盲评。

与此同时，我们没有看到任何证据表明模型可以提出专家认为总体贡献更好的研究思路。他们在研究的技术部分越来越好，但在更主观的部分却不一定。

这可能是因为人类专家拥有模型所没有的“判断力”。

也可能是研究“贡献”是如此主观，以至于它实际上并没有指向任何有意义的目标——与这种可能性相一致，我们发现我们的人类专家在对项目想法的贡献强度进行评级时彼此不一致，一致率仅略高于随机机会。也许社会科学研究就是 @alexolegimas 所说的“关系善”：人们之所以重视它，部分原因是它是由人类产生的。我们不确定。

今年一月，我发布了一个试点结果，其中我让 Claude Code 复制并扩展了过去关于邮件投票的实证论文。 10 个月后，所取得的进展令人震惊。问人工智能是否可以自动收集数据并进行分析已经不再有趣了——我们认为这是理所当然的——相反，问题是人工智能可以完成整个研究循环的多少。我们的初步答案是：人工智能可以从头到尾处理实证政治经济学研究的技术方面，设计并执行它，但目前，我们仍然需要人类来推动议程。

这是与@AndyCWMyers 的联合工作，当然是献给我的博士生导师吉姆·斯奈德（Jim Snyder），无论人工智能与否，他仍然是世界上伟大的实证政治经济学家。

celebrity.content_snippet: Wow. President Trump personally called into the Nvidia board meeting to argue for Jensen's return as CEO. Just insane turn of events.
celebrity.summary_en: Wow. President Trump personally called into the Nvidia board meeting to argue for Jensen's return as CEO. Just insane turn of events.
celebrity.summary_zh: 白宫周一证实，唐纳德·特朗普总统“完全参与”了英伟达恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官的决定。 Semafor 援引知情人士的话报道称，在董事会投票决定召回黄仁勋的几个小时前，特朗普加入了与英伟达董事会的电话会议，阐述了召回黄仁勋的理由。 ”P
celebrity.article_content:
The White House confirmed Monday that President Donald Trump was "totally involved" in Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

Trump joined a call with Nvidia's board to make the case for bringing Huang back, hours before directors voted to do it, Semafor reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

"President Trump was totally involved and this is a great decision by the NVIDIA board. We have to protect our geniuses," White House communications director Steven Cheung told Semafor.

The board met late Sunday night and voted unanimously, according to Semafor. Asked by CNBC on Monday whether he dialed into the meeting himself, Trump said he'd rather not say but that he was "represented." He told CNBC he spoke with the board and with Huang ahead of the announcement.

Nvidia said it had received input from "senior levels of the United States government" and was confident Huang posed no national security risk, despite his affair with a woman U.S. intelligence suspects of spying for China.

Some directors had kept pushing for Huang's return after he left. Their opponents lost momentum when Arm CEO Rene Haas, seen as a top choice to succeed Huang, signed on to stay at Arm through 2033, a person familiar with some directors' thinking told Semafor.

Board chair Harvey Jones, who took the role when Huang resigned Nov. 12, called Huang "the right person to lead NVIDIA."

Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and led its rise as the dominant maker of AI chips. Along with the affair, he faced reports of relationships with Nvidia employees, including one who reported directly to him.

Nvidia's stock jumped nearly 30% in early trading Monday, its biggest gain in more than two decades, according to Semafor.

Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-MA), the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, called the board's decision "reckless" and said Huang's return makes it more urgent to pass bipartisan export control bills.

celebrity.title: The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more import
celebrity.title_en:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes

celebrity.quote_zh:
Motes 生态系统的下一阶段越来越近，社区参与也将变得更加重要。

@meetmotes 正准备启动 Motes Aura 积分测试网，引入一个将用户活动与未来分配机会联系起来的积分系统。

我们的想法是让参与变得有价值。当用户与生态系统互动并与其人工智能代理基础设施互动时，他们的活动可以有助于赚取 Aura 积分。

这些积分旨在在分配机会中发挥作用，为用户提供另一个保持活跃并探索 Motes 正在构建的内容的理由。

有趣的是这如何与更大的愿景联系起来：Genesis NFT 引入了专用人工智能代理的所有权和访问权限，而 Aura 创建了另一层来奖励经过验证的参与。

这不再只是持有 NFT 了。参与生态系统也很重要。

创世第一。接下来是$MOTES。

Aura Points 测试网即将推出。做好准备！

celebrity.content_snippet:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes

celebrity.summary_zh:
互动并与其人工智能代理基础设施互动时，他们的活动可以有助于赚取 Aura 积分。

这些积分旨在在分配机会中发挥作用，为用户提供另一个保持活跃并探索 Motes 正在构建的内容的理由。

有趣的是这如何与更大的愿景联系起来：Genesis NFT 引入了专用人工智能代理的所有权和访问权限，而 Aura 创建了另一层来奖励经过验证的参与。

7. make a UGC video ad for $4 that used to cost $500

8. scrape everyone who engaged with a linkedin post and drop them into a cold email sequence

9. run your whole GTM off one postgres database with three tables: accounts, people and signals

13. run every hard decision through gemini as a second opinion

14. turn every marketing job you do into a skill and give it to the whole team

15. and so much more its brain breaking

This is the greatest time to be building and it isn't even close.

现在的情况很疯狂：

4. 让您的代理从聊天中租用自己的 GPU

5. 将 REA 指向您付费的任何应用程序并重建您喜欢的功能

6. 让 Claude Code 在品牌静态广告上制作 100+ 并通过 API 上传到 Facebook

9. 在一个包含三个表的 postgres 数据库上运行整个 GTM：帐户、人员和信号

10. 给 grok 机器人一个开发者机器人和一个 PM 机器人，让他们全天发送 Pull 请求

11. 在团队的 Slack 和视频通话中添加一个 Grok 机器人，以便它记笔记并跟进截止日期

12.让代理通过其MCP在davinciresolve中编辑您的视频

13.通过双子座作为第二意见来做出每一个艰难的决定

14.将你所做的每一项营销工作变成一项技能，并将其传授给整个团队

15. 还有更多令人伤脑筋的事情

这是建设的最佳时机，而且还远未结束。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: vLLM开源推理框架发布v0.34版本，核心改进在于引入可扩展的KV缓存机制，利用GPU虚拟内存API实现缓存容量自动分配。该更新废弃了手动调节参数，支持包括Llama 3.2在内的10种新模型，显著降低了大模型在异构环境下的显存调优成本。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The vLLM inference framework released v0.34, introducing an extensible KV cache mechanism that leverages the GPU's virtual memory API for automated capacity management. This update deprecates manual tuning flags and adds support for 10 new models, effectively lowering deployment friction for large language models.

elements_zh.where: 模型推理部署领域
elements_zh.what: 发布v0.34版本，实现KV缓存容量的动态自动管理，不再强制配置gpu-memory-utilization参数
elements_zh.why: 旨在优化大模型推理场景下的显存利用效率与部署流程便捷性

elements_en.what: Released v0.34, enabling dynamic KV cache management via virtual memory API, removing the need for manual memory utilization configuration
elements_en.why: To optimize GPU memory efficiency and streamline deployment workflows for LLMs

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 显存动态管理是降低大模型私有化部署门槛的关键技术点，vLLM通过抽象底层硬件调度进一步巩固了其作为高性能推理引擎的市场标准地位。对于开发者而言，减少显存碎片化与参数手动配置，将使推理层的业务集成效率获得阶梯性提升。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Dynamic memory management is a critical bottleneck for private model deployment, and vLLM's abstraction of hardware-level scheduling reinforces its position as the industry-standard inference engine. For developers, automating memory allocation reduces fragmentation and deployment friction, significantly accelerating production-level integration.

celebrity.title_en:
At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but implementing them remains painfully slow.

I’ll explain. But since I’m new to posting on X, let me first introduce myself. 

I’m Barak,  a founder/investor with 2 exits and 3 IPOs. 
My cofounders and I started Bonobo AI, which was acquired in 2019 by Salesforce. There, we worked to help build the next generation of enterprise AI from the inside. 

I like to describe us as four Lego pieces: We fit together perfectly, complementing each other's strengths and building something stronger than the sum of its parts. That understanding allows us to move quickly, challenge one another without ego and operate as one team. 

It's also what brought us back together to build JUNE AI. 
Because while working at the heart of enterprise AI, we kept seeing the same problem: enterprise AI implementation is a massive undertaking.

The challenge is not simply choosing the right model. Enterprises want to move faster with AI, but the systems running their businesses are holding them back.

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘.
June turns the traditionally complex implementation of enterprise systems, AI agents, and data platforms into a plug-and-play moment, so businesses can grow and leverage AI without the wait.

June is built to work across the enterprise platforms your business relies on like (such as Salesforce, Databricks, Oracle, Workday, HubSpot, OpenAI, Anthropic, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft, and Snowflake)

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. Evolve safely: From discovery to production, every change is reviewed, sandbox-tested, and executed through native tools - fully auditable at every step.

2. Own the logic: June turns buried configuration into plain-language business rules, independent of any platform, so no vendor holds your logic.

3. Transform at any size: No downtime, no matter how complex the environment. June reads and understands your systems, whether legacy, custom-built, or brand new.

Thank you to @Benioff  and Time Ventures for leading our round, with @MichaelDell, @levie, @George_Kurtz, and Diane Greene participating.

We've done this once together. The problem this time is a lot bigger.

I'll be writing about my experiences as an investor and founder, and about what it takes to get AI out of the pilot and into production.

If that interests you, follow along for the journey.

celebrity.quote_zh:
在 June AI，我们筹集了 2000 万美元来解决人工智能中最大的问题：模型正在以惊人的速度前进，但实施它们仍然非常缓慢。

我会解释一下。但由于我是 X 上的新手，所以让我先自我介绍一下。

我是 Barak，一位创始人/投资者，拥有 2 次退出和 3 次 IPO。
我和我的联合创始人创立了 Bonobo AI，该公司于 2019 年被 Salesforce 收购。在那里，我们致力于从内部帮助构建下一代企业人工智能。

我喜欢将我们描述为四块乐高积木：我们完美地组合在一起，互补彼此的优势，并构建出比各部分总和更强大的东西。这种理解使我们能够快速行动，不以自我为中心互相挑战，并作为一个团队运作。

这也是我们重新聚在一起打造 JUNE AI 的原因。
因为在研究企业人工智能的核心时，我们不断看到同样的问题：企业人工智能的实施是一项艰巨的任务。

挑战不仅仅是选择正确的模型。企业希望利用人工智能更快地发展，但运行其业务的系统却阻碍了他们。

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘀𝘄𝗵𝘆𝘄𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘。
June 将传统上复杂的企业系统、人工智能代理和数据平台的实施转变为即插即用的时刻，因此企业可以无需等待即可发展和利用人工智能。

June 旨在跨您的业务所依赖的企业平台（例如 Salesforce、Databricks、Oracle、Workday、HubSpot、OpenAI、Anthropic、ServiceNow、SAP、Microsoft 和 Snowflake）工作

celebrity.full_text_en:
At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but implementing them remains painfully slow.

I’ll explain. But since I’m new to posting on X, let me first introduce myself. 

I’m Barak,  a founder/investor with 2 exits and 3 IPOs. 
My cofounders and I started Bonobo AI, which was acquired in 2019 by Salesforce. There, we worked to help build the next generation of enterprise AI from the inside. 

I like to describe us as four Lego pieces: We fit together perfectly, complementing each other's strengths and building something stronger than the sum of its parts. That understanding allows us to move quickly, challenge one another without ego and operate as one team. 

It's also what brought us back together to build JUNE AI. 
Because while working at the heart of enterprise AI, we kept seeing the same problem: enterprise AI implementation is a massive undertaking.

The challenge is not simply choosing the right model. Enterprises want to move faster with AI, but the systems running their businesses are holding them back.

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘.
June turns the traditionally complex implementation of enterprise systems, AI agents, and data platforms into a plug-and-play moment, so businesses can grow and leverage AI without the wait.

June is built to work across the enterprise platforms your business relies on like (such as Salesforce, Databricks, Oracle, Workday, HubSpot, OpenAI, Anthropic, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft, and Snowflake)

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. Evolve safely: From discovery to production, every change is reviewed, sandbox-tested, and executed through native tools - fully auditable at every step.

2. Own the logic: June turns buried configuration into plain-language business rules, independent of any platform, so no vendor holds your logic.

3. Transform at any size: No downtime, no matter how complex the environment. June reads and understands your systems, whether legacy, custom-built, or brand new.

Thank you to @Benioff  and Time Ventures for leading our round, with @MichaelDell, @levie, @George_Kurtz, and Diane Greene participating.

We've done this once together. The problem this time is a lot bigger.

I'll be writing about my experiences as an investor and founder, and about what it takes to get AI out of the pilot and into production.

If that interests you, follow along for the journey.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 云基础设施服务商Nebius联合英伟达将于12月3日演示NVIDIA Agent Harness在零售场景的自动化部署。该蓝图旨在定义AI代理在处理液体泄漏或收银排队激增等突发状况时的执行边界与权限控制，确保其在合规范围内实现业务响应。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Cloud infrastructure provider Nebius and NVIDIA will demonstrate the NVIDIA Agent Harness for Store Operations on December 3. The initiative aims to define execution boundaries and authorization limits for AI agents handling operational incidents like spills or checkout queues, ensuring autonomous compliance.

elements_zh.who: Nebius（云服务商）与英伟达（NVIDIA，计算平台提供商）
elements_zh.where: 线上实测演示（12月3日）
elements_zh.what: 展示NVIDIA Agent Harness零售运营蓝图，重点在于AI代理的权限约束与业务场景响应逻辑
elements_zh.why: 解决大模型驱动的自动化代理在零售复杂环境中的“越权执行”与操作规范化难题

elements_en.what: NVIDIA Agent Harness Store Operations Blueprint, focusing on agent guardrails and authorization logic.
elements_en.why: Addressing the challenge of preventing AI agents from exceeding authority in real-world retail environments.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: AI代理从实验室走向物理生产环境的核心瓶颈在于“权限边界控制”与“动作执行容错”。通过标准化蓝图将Agent执行逻辑架构化，标志着英伟达正在从单一硬件输出向行业级边缘智能的控制协议渗透，试图构筑物理世界的数字操作标准。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The bottleneck for AI agents moving into physical production environments lies in authorization boundaries and error handling. By formalizing these logic gates, NVIDIA is shifting from a hardware-centric model to establishing control protocols for edge intelligence, aiming to define industry standards for autonomous physical operations.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 云基础设施服务商Nebius联合英伟达将于12月3日演示NVIDIA Agent Harness在零售场景的自动化部署。该蓝图旨在定义AI代理在处理液体泄漏或收银排队激增等突发状况时的执行边界与权限控制，确保其在合规范围内实现业务响应。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Cloud infrastructure provider Nebius and NVIDIA will demonstrate the NVIDIA Agent Harness for Store Operations on December 3. The initiative aims to define execution boundaries and authorization limits for AI agents handling operational incidents like spills or checkout queues, ensuring autonomous compliance.
key_points_zh: 针对零售门店突发场景的AI自动化治理需求
NVIDIA Agent Harness蓝图的权限控制与边界设定机制
12月3日举行技术演示并开放测试验证
key_points_en: Addressing AI automation needs for retail operational incidents
Permission control and boundary settings within the NVIDIA Agent Harness
Technical demonstration scheduled for December 3rd

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 视频生成领域的竞争已从单纯的画质指标博弈转向推理成本（Inference Cost）的极限优化。MAGI-2将生成成本压降至0.08美元/秒，意味着视频生成正从“贵族式”创意辅助向高频工业化生产工具跨越，这将迫使现有高价模型通过算法瘦身或更激进的量化方案来维持市场份额。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Competition in generative video has shifted from mere quality metrics to the limits of inference cost optimization. By driving costs down to $0.08 per second, MAGI-2 signals a transition from boutique creative tools to industrial-grade production, forcing incumbents to adopt aggressive weight pruning or quantization strategies to remain competitive.

HONG KONG, Aug. 13, 2026 (SEND2PRESS NEWSWIRE) — AI Inspo announced the availability of Seedance 2.5 on its creative platform on Aug. 7, giving users access to the latest AI video technology through a simple, cost-effective workspace. The platform brings multiple generative AI models together in one place, allowing users to explore and create without switching between different services.

Image caption: Seedance 2.5 is now available on AI Inspo for 30-second AI video generation.

Seedance 2.5 is available now on AI Inspo: https://www.ai-inspo.com/model/seedance-2-5

Seedance 2.5 is designed to maintain character and scene consistency across longer shots while delivering realistic motion and smooth transitions. Compared with the previous 15-second limit, Seedance 2.5 extends maximum duration to 30 seconds and adds native audio, helping creators produce more complete visual stories within a single workflow.

Seedance 2.5 is well suited for social media content, product commercials, cinematic sequences, and other short-form video projects, combining longer video durations, multimodal references, and native audio in a single workflow.

Seedance 2.5 supports multimodal inputs, allowing users to combine text, image, video, and audio references in a single workflow. On AI Inspo, it enables both text-to-video and image-to-video generation with native audio. Users can also adjust video duration, aspect ratio, camera movement, and output resolution to fit their creative needs.

From social media posts and product commercials to cinematic sequences and visual storytelling, Seedance 2.5 suits a wide range of short-form video projects.

Through AI Inspo’s browser-based workspace, users can upload reference materials, enter prompts, generate videos, preview results, refine their ideas, and export finished content without installing additional software. New users can also claim free credits to try Seedance 2.5.

AI Inspo is a browser-based creative workspace that brings AI video, image, and music generation together in one platform. It gives creators access to leading generative AI models, including Seedance 2.5, Veo 3, Kling 3.0, and MiniMax H3, through a single interface.

Built for creators, marketers, and businesses, AI Inspo makes AI-powered content creation more accessible and efficient. By bringing the latest AI models and creative technologies into one cost-effective workspace, the platform enables users to explore different tools and create content without switching between multiple services.

More information: https://www.ai-inspo.com/

VIDEO (YouTube): https://youtu.be/yYBRDjQXGVE

celebrity.article_content:
ByteDance raised the ceiling on AI video generation Tuesday when it announced Seedance 2.5 at the Volcano Engine FORCE conference in Beijing — a model that, the company claims, can generate a single continuous 30-second clip without stitching shorter segments together. If those claims survive independent testing when the model launches in early July, Seedance 2.5 will mark the first major closed commercial AI video tool to reach that duration natively, without segment breaks.

The announcement arrives four months after ByteDance voluntarily paused the global rollout of its predecessor, Seedance 2.0, following cease-and-desist letters from every major Hollywood studio over alleged copyright infringement. Those legal disputes remain unresolved. The central question hanging over the June 23 event is whether Seedance 2.5 carries the same legal exposure — or whether the intervening months of remediation work have changed the equation for enterprise buyers.

Until now, professional AI video generators from Runway Gen-4.5, Google Veo 3.1, and OpenAI's Sora 2 — which was shut down on April 26, 2026 — topped out at roughly 8 to 15 seconds per native clip. Generating longer sequences required stitching shorter clips end-to-end, a process that introduces visible seams between segments, character faces that drift in appearance between shots, and lighting inconsistencies that mark the footage as artificial. Television commercials, social media ads, explainer videos, and short documentary segments all cluster in the 15–60 second range. A tool that can hold visual and audio consistency across an entire half-minute without a stitch changes the production economics for that entire format category.

ByteDance describes the architecture behind that consistency as a unified joint audio-video generation system, in which visual and audio signals are co-processed inside the same latent space rather than generated separately and synchronized after the fact. Combined with what the company calls optimized spatial-temporal attention mechanisms, the model holds character appearance, lighting, and motion style across the full clip duration. ByteDance announced Seedance 2.5 on stage, not as a shipped product — it is currently in global enterprise beta, with a public launch targeted for early July 2026. No pricing has been disclosed. All claimed capabilities are ByteDance's own statements; no independent benchmarks exist yet for Seedance 2.5.

Seedance 2.5 ships with three generation modes. Text-to-video produces a clip from a written prompt alone. Image-to-video animates a still image into a moving scene. A motion-reference mode uses an existing video clip to guide the movement style of a new generation — useful for advertisers or filmmakers who want to replicate a specific camera technique or action choreography without sourcing live footage.

The model's reference input capacity is a more significant upgrade than the generation modes alone suggest. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 50 simultaneous multimodal reference materials — images, video clips, and audio files — compared to roughly 12 in Seedance 2.0. Volcano Engine president Tan Dai told the conference that this capacity is designed for brand-consistency and episodic storytelling workflows, where the model must lock a character's face, a product's appearance, an art style, and a music reference across an entire generation without drifting. Google's Veo 3.1, the closest Western competitor for reference control, accepts only three reference inputs — making the gap between the two substantial for production use cases that require strict consistency.

The system also introduces localized region editing: a creator can redraw one specific element in a frame — swap a character's clothing, change a background element, alter a product in a scene — without regenerating the entire clip. That capability addresses one of the most costly friction points in AI video production, where fixing one small error currently requires starting over and hoping the rest of the output survives intact.

How the Architecture Differs From Seedance 2.0

The distinction between Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 is not simply longer output — it is a change in how longer output is produced. Seedance 2.0 could produce clips of up to 15 seconds natively, and could reach 30 seconds only through sequential stitching, which meant extended output was a composite of shorter generated segments joined at their boundaries. Seedance 2.5, according to ByteDance, generates the entire 30-second clip as a single coherent diffusion pass. The spatial-temporal attention mechanisms that enable this hold object identity and scene state across a longer temporal horizon than previous diffusion window approaches could sustain.

ByteDance's predecessor had already established an independent quality benchmark before this announcement. On the Artificial Analysis Video Arena — a blind human-preference leaderboard that assigns scores through paired comparisons — Seedance 2.0 currently ranks first for text-to-video with audio, with an Elo score of 1,218, ahead of Kling 3.0 and Google Veo 3.1. That ranking reflects the shipping version of Seedance 2.0. No Seedance 2.5 score exists yet; benchmark numbers will not be reliable until the model is publicly available and independently tested.

ByteDance also announced at the same event that Seedance 2.0 has been upgraded to support native 4K output with 10-bit color depth — a separate improvement that benefits development teams already integrated with the current model. The company said its enterprise Seedance platform has reached $2 billion in annual recurring revenue, a figure that signals commercial traction ahead of the 2.5 launch.

Seedance 2.5 will be distributed through ByteDance's Volcano Engine cloud platform, with additional reach through CapCut — the video editing application with more than 400 million monthly active users — as well as the Dreamina and Doubao consumer interfaces.

Before committing to a Seedance 2.5 integration, development teams should weigh several operational factors that the conference announcement left unresolved.

No independent benchmark exists yet. All described capabilities — 30-second single-pass generation, 50-reference input handling, regional editing stability — are ByteDance's stated specifications from the June 23 keynote. They are consistent across multiple reporters covering the event and are plausible given the architecture, but they have not been verified by third-party testing. Early July access will provide the first real opportunity for external evaluation.

Copyright filters are active. Following the Motion Picture Association's formal cease-and-desist action against Seedance 2.0 in February 2026, ByteDance added content filters that block generation of recognizable real faces and copyrighted characters. Those filters remain active in the current model and are expected to carry forward into 2.5.

Pricing is undisclosed. Seedance 2.0 was priced at roughly $2.50 per 15-second clip on some third-party inference platforms. Seedance 2.5's cost structure has not been announced and may change the cost-per-second economics of longer clips.

The Unresolved Copyright Situation From Seedance 2.0

The context a developer evaluating Seedance 2.5 cannot ignore is the legal record of its predecessor. When Seedance 2.0 launched in China in February 2026, the Motion Picture Association described the tool's copyright infringement as "a feature, not a bug" in a formal cease-and-desist letter — the first such letter the MPA had ever sent to a major generative AI company. Disney, Warner Bros. Discovery, Paramount, Netflix, Sony Pictures, and Universal all sent their own cease-and-desist letters within days of the launch. SAG-AFTRA condemned the model's ability to produce realistic actor likenesses without consent.

ByteDance pledged to strengthen safeguards and voluntarily paused the global rollout in March 2026. As of May 2026, no federal lawsuit had been filed in the United States and no government had formally banned the model in any country — though US Senators Marsha Blackburn and Peter Welch had written to ByteDance's CEO demanding the model be shut down. The enforcement challenge is partly structural: serving legal process on a China-based company under the Hague Convention takes an estimated 18 to 24 months, a timeline that has given Chinese AI video companies a significant advantage over Hollywood's legal timeline.

ByteDance previewed a new AI copyright commercialization platform at the same FORCE conference, with filmmaker Stephen Chow named as an initial partner. Whether that platform meaningfully addresses the concerns raised by the studios — or whether the same generation capabilities that triggered Seedance 2.0's controversy carry forward into Seedance 2.5 — will only be assessed once independent testers gain public access in July.

ByteDance is headquartered in Beijing. China's National Intelligence Law, passed in June 2017, requires under Article 7 that "all organizations and citizens shall support, assist, and cooperate with national intelligence efforts in accordance with law." That requirement applies to ByteDance and its subsidiaries. China's Cybersecurity Law (2017) additionally requires businesses operating in China to store data on servers within China and permits Chinese authorities to conduct spot inspections of network operations.

The Chinese government holds a 1% "golden share" with a board seat in ByteDance's main Chinese subsidiary, Beijing ByteDance Technology, with a government official whose background is in propaganda appointed to that seat. ByteDance has maintained an internal Chinese Communist Party committee since 2014. The company has a strategic partnership with China's Ministry of Public Security. The US Department of Homeland Security has assessed that Chinese companies are "required to secretly share data with the PRC government or other entities upon request, even if that request is illegal under the jurisdiction in which these firms operate."

ByteDance has denied sharing user data with the Chinese government and states that its data practices comply with US law. A tool that can hold visual and audio consistency across an entire half-minute without a stitch changes the production economics for that entire format category.

Combined with what the company calls optimized spatial-temporal attention mechanisms, the model holds character appearance, lighting, and motion style across the full clip duration. The model's reference input capacity is a more significant upgrade than the generation modes alone suggest. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 50 simultaneous multimodal reference materials — images, video clips, and audio files — compared to roughly 12 in Seedance 2.0. Volcano Engine president Tan Dai told the conference that this capacity is designed for brand-consistency and episodic storytelling workflows, where the model must lock a character's face, a product's appearance, an art style, and a music reference across an entire generation without drifting. Google's Veo 3.1, the closest Western competitor for reference control, accepts only three reference inputs — making the gap between the two substantial for production use cases that require strict consistency.

The system also introduces localized region editing: a creator can redraw one specific element in a frame — swap a character's clothing, change a background element, alter a product in a scene — without regenerating the entire clip. celebrity.summary_zh: 开发者利用Claude Code构建由16个代理组成的自治系统，探索从底层流程构建向最终产品交付的演进。
celebrity.summary_en: A developer built an autonomous system comprising 16 agents using Claude Code. The project initially focused on workflow orchestration and debugging complex agentic interactions, transitioning from systemic process building to final product delivery.
celebrity.article_content_zh:
在构建多代理系统的过程中，研发者发现核心难点在于处理系统性损坏（Systemic Failure）。通过Claude Code，研发者将初期重心放在代理协作流程（Workflow）的编排上，而非急于产出功能模块。

项目调整重点在于优化多代理状态机的上下文传递逻辑，确保系统在面临复杂代码变更时能自动处理依赖冲突，从而实现了从纯粹研发流程到实际工程产品的跨越。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 开发者基于Anthropic推出的Claude Code工具构建了包含16个协作节点的自治代理系统。该项目在初期侧重于研发工作流的逻辑编排与故障调试，旨在解决多代理环境下的任务分配与状态一致性问题，目前已推进至产品化交付阶段。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: A developer built an autonomous system comprising 16 agents using Claude Code. The project initially focused on workflow orchestration and debugging complex agentic interactions, transitioning from systemic process building to final product delivery.

elements_zh.where: Claude Code开发环境
elements_zh.what: 部署16个代理组成的自治系统，重构流程逻辑以适配产品交付需求
elements_zh.why: 旨在验证多代理协作在复杂工程任务中的鲁棒性与自动化效率

elements_en.what: Deployed an autonomous system of 16 agents, refactoring workflows for product delivery
elements_en.why: To validate the robustness and efficiency of multi-agent collaboration in complex engineering tasks

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 多代理系统（MAS）的研发重心正从单点任务自动化向长链条、高可靠性的产品级工作流迁移。Claude Code类工具显著降低了环境配置门槛，但多代理间的上下文传递与冲突裁决仍是当前系统架构设计的关键技术瓶颈。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The focus of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) is shifting from discrete task automation to high-reliability, long-chain product workflows. While tools like Claude Code significantly lower the barrier to entry, resolving context propagation and conflict arbitration remains the primary technical bottleneck for production-grade agentic architecture.

ai_analysis.digest_en: A developer built an autonomous system comprising 16 agents using Claude Code. The project initially focused on workflow orchestration and debugging complex agentic interactions, transitioning from systemic process building to final product delivery.

celebrity.summary_en: Google has established a hard deadline of February 1, 2027, for all third-party AI agents interacting with Workspace components like Gmail, Drive, and Calendar. celebrity.article_content:
Kling AI Launches Kling Image 4.0 with Photographic Realism and Native 8K Generation Tweet

Beijing,China, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kling AI, the AI-powered creative platform, today announced the launch of Kling Image 4.0, its latest image generation model that combines photographic realism, native 8K output, advanced text generation, and the ability to generate up to 10 cohesive images from a single prompt.

Designed for everyday creators and professionals in filmmaking, advertising, marketing, and design, the model also offers improved instruction following and more precise control over image composition, able to help creators to turn complex briefs into individual images or complete visual sets.

According to the latest Artificial Analysis image leaderboard, Kling Image 4.0 Preview maintains a leading position in both text-to-image and image editing. Its text-to-image capabilities rank third in the UIUX Design scenarios, according to the leaderboard.

Kling Image 4.0 creates images with the natural look of photographs that are taken straight from the camera, combining soft lighting, lifelike textures, and fine detail. The generated image can capture subtle human facial expressions and renders subjects that fit naturally into their surroundings.

In group portraits, the model produces greater variation in facial features, body types, ages, and poses to avoid the common issue in image genertion - that all people look identical. This gives creators more flexibility to develop diverse casts and visually expressive scenes.

Kling Image 4.0 for the first time in the industry supports AI image generation with native 8K resolution. It renders fine details across skin, fabric, product materials, and landscapes, so that intricate details remain sharp even in close-up views and extensive cropping, making it well suited for professional visual production.

The higher-resolution output also supports a range of professional applications, from digital campaigns and product imagery to large-format displays and outdoor advertising.

Kling Image 4.0 introduces enhanced text rendering, pairing clear, legible text with expressive layouts. It supports generating up to 2,000 characters in a single image and integrates text with other visual elements, maintaining clarity even for small text in posters. Creators can also edit text content and font styles within generated images to match their creative vision.

The built-in font library offers over 70 preset fonts, and creators can also upload font reference images to guide the desired style. From artistic lettering to multi-level poster layouts, Kling Image 4.0 precisely follows instructions for text placement, typography, and visual effects, bringing text and imagery together in cohesive designs.

Kling Image 4.0 further improves its multilingual capabilities, supporting text generation in English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, simplified Chinese and traditional Chinese. This opens up more possibilities for text-based visual creation across languages.

With a single prompt, creators can generate a set of up to 10 related images. Kling Image 4.0 interprets the overall brief and plans the set as a whole, maintaining a consistent visual style and subject identity while varying framing, camera angles, and content. This reduces the need to generate and adjust each image individually.

The model adapts the set to the task: planning shots and narrative flow for storyboards, showcasing product angles and key selling points for e-commerce, and organizing layouts and information across presentation visuals.

Kling Image 4.0 also supports the creation of long-form e-commerce product pages and brand website visuals, combining product imagery, key information and brand elements into cohesive layouts. Text and images can be edited on separate layers, making revisions easier.

The launch of Kling Image 4.0 follows the recent launch of Kling 4.0, its latest video generation model featuring major improvements in visual realism, creative control and narrative coherence. From single image to complete visual sets, Kling Image 4.0 brings AI image generation closer to production-grade delivery, enabling creators in film, advertising, and marketing to turn ambitious ideas into finished work with consistency and speed.

celebrity.article_content:
AI-generated illustration Key Points Google now treats autonomous agents as a distinct security class requiring policy…View moreGoogle now treats autonomous agents as a distinct security class requiring policy checks and human confirmation.Third-party agent platforms face a compliance deadline as the Workspace AI Tools Addendum bans circumventing MCP.Agent Gateway enforces default-deny outbound rules and screens traffic for indirect prompt injection. Google announced on November 24, 2026 that its Workspace Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and Workspace command-line interface (CLI) are generally available, alongside rules requiring AI agents to use those interfaces instead of existing REST APIs. Technical enforcement begins February 1, 2027.

Google reports that Workspace APIs handle more than 2.8 trillion calls a month, with public Drive API traffic more than two-and-a-half times its 2022 volume. Traditional applications can continue using existing REST APIs; the new requirement applies to AI agents and other AI-driven tools.

Google’s rationale is that traditional REST APIs were built for human-paced applications, where a valid OAuth token implied user intent. An autonomous agent acting at machine speed across email, documents and cloud infrastructure changes that assumption. The new design puts policy checks, data boundaries and human confirmation into the request path.

The Workspace servers use MCP to give AI applications a standard way to read data and take actions. Dedicated remote servers are generally available for Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat and Tasks, inheriting each user’s permissions and data-governance controls. The Workspace CLI serves local agents, terminal workflows and automation, with structured JSON output and scoped OAuth sign-in across Workspace services.

Each agent call through these interfaces is checked against organizational permissions, data-loss-prevention rules and classification labels. The MCP servers reject OAuth clients that are not designated for AI agents, and agents connecting to Workspace must use dedicated OAuth client IDs with least-privilege scopes and usage quotas. Billing is scheduled to begin on April 1, 2027, while time-limited approvals are listed as coming soon.

Draft creation and document summarization can run autonomously. Sending email, changing Drive sharing permissions and making bulk edits require explicit user confirmation. Workspace administrators can view, audit and revoke agents in the admin console; user-facing activity review and revocation, plus controls to block agent access to Gmail messages and specific Drive files or folders, remain forthcoming.

The Workspace AI Tools Addendum covers standalone agents, the software harnesses that deploy or orchestrate them, and applications or services using AI models. It bars disguising a tool to avoid classification or circumvent the Google MCP requirement. That makes the migration a compliance issue for third-party agent platforms as well as for developers building directly on Workspace.

Workspace user data and Google Technical Information, a category of service information obtained or derived through Workspace access points, may be processed only to fulfill active, user-authorized tasks. Neither category can be used for model training, fine-tuning, evaluation dataset construction, model distillation or developing a service similar to a Workspace service. Scraping and systematic probing beyond what an authorized task requires are also prohibited.

Google Technical Information cannot be stored for more than 30 days. Covered user data and technical information must not be retained after a tool is disconnected or its access is revoked. If Google reasonably believes those rules have been violated, it can immediately restrict or remove the tool’s access, or suspend or terminate the customer’s access to the relevant Workspace services.

On Google Cloud, Agent Gateway verifies Agent Identities against the Agent Registry directory, enforces identity and access management policies and default-deny outbound rules, and screens requests with Model Armor. It governs inbound client-to-agent traffic and outbound requests from agents to tools, APIs and other agents. Custom authorization checks can be delegated to an organization’s own policy engine or third-party security tools through Service Extensions.

Cloud Run support and Agent Gateway for cross-cloud Kubernetes environments remain in Limited Preview. Each gateway instance can govern up to 5,000 resources registered in Agent Registry.

Google’s MCP configuration guide requires screening prompts and responses for indirect prompt injection, meaning hidden instructions in untrusted content, using Model Armor or a documented alternative. Malicious emails or documents could hijack a session and modify, steal or delete data. Current known issues include some English-only approval prompts, no user self-service viewing or revocation of saved tool approvals, and expiration of those approvals after 90 days.

For enterprises, agent governance is now built into the supported Workspace access path. The practical burden is the migration: existing agent integrations must satisfy the new identity, confirmation, screening and retention rules on Google’s schedule, while parts of the user-control and deployment model remain pending.

celebrity.summary_zh: 谷歌正式发布Workspace MCP服务器与CLI工具，强制要求AI代理通过专用网关接入，以实现合规性审核与DLP数据泄露防护。
celebrity.summary_en: Google announced the general availability of Workspace MCP servers and CLI on November 24, 2026, mandating that AI agents use these interfaces for interaction. Effective February 1, 2027, this shift forces agents to operate through an Agent Gateway with built-in DLP and audit capabilities, treating agents as a distinct security classification.
celebrity.article_content_zh:
谷歌通过Agent Gateway重新定义了企业工作区的数据交互权限。传统的REST API在处理人类行为时具备有效的OAuth令牌保障，但面对高速、自动化的AI代理时，其安全边界显得极为脆弱。新的MCP接口直接在请求路径上集成了DLP审查和人工确认流程。

该协议将Gmail、Drive、Docs、Sheets等服务封装为受控节点。AI代理在调用这些服务时，必须使用专用的OAuth客户端ID，且在执行敏感操作（如发送邮件、修改Drive权限、批量编辑文档）时，必须获得用户明确确认。此举实际上将第三方代理彻底纳入了谷歌云的安全合规监控网格内。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌于2026年11月24日宣布全面推出Workspace MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器与CLI，并规定AI代理需摒弃传统REST API，转而通过具备DLP检查与审计功能的Agent Gateway接入工作区数据。该举措自2027年2月1日起正式强制执行，旨在将AI代理定义为需严格权限管控的新型安全类别。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google announced the general availability of Workspace MCP servers and CLI on November 24, 2026, mandating that AI agents use these interfaces for interaction. Effective February 1, 2027, this shift forces agents to operate through an Agent Gateway with built-in DLP and audit capabilities, treating agents as a distinct security classification.

elements_zh.where: 企业级AI合规部署环境
elements_zh.what: 强制要求AI代理使用MCP协议与Agent Gateway，屏蔽旧有REST API路径
elements_zh.why: 应对AI代理自动化操作带来的安全隐患与数据泄露风险

elements_en.what: Mandating MCP and Agent Gateway, deprecating REST API usage for AI agents
elements_en.why: Addressing security and data leakage risks from autonomous agent operations

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 这是全球首个将AI代理合规治理从软件层拉入协议层的重大举措，标志着谷歌通过控制数据链路底层协议，实质性垄断了企业级AI代理的操作标准。通过强制调用MCP，谷歌不仅防范了提示词注入，更将数据权限边界直接植入代理的执行逻辑，迫使第三方代理平台必须服从其统一的安全审计框架。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This is a seminal move to shift AI agent governance from software-level to protocol-level, effectively enabling Google to set the standard for enterprise agent interactions. By mandating MCP, Google mitigates prompt injection risks while embedding data governance directly into execution logic, forcing third-party platforms to comply with its proprietary security auditing framework.

celebrity.title_en:
Demon Slayer, Street Fighter and Shield Hero Voice Actor, Stephen Fu Celebrates 41! 🎙️🔥🎮

Stephen Fu has quickly become a familiar voice across modern anime and gaming, bringing a striking range of heroes, villains, and fan favorites to life. His chilling performance as Douma in Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba stands alongside major game roles like Iron Fist / Lin Lie in Marvel Rivals, Jamie in Street Fighter 6, and Hwei in League of Legends.

Anime fans also know him as Naofumi Iwatani in The Rising of the Shield Hero, Weather Report in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean, Sakuta Azusagawa in Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai, and Lance Crown in Mashle: Magic and Muscles. Newer roles such as Anaxa in Honkai: Star Rail, Natsuki Seba in Sakamoto Days, and Naito Mudano in Tougen Anki continue to expand an already impressive résumé.

Some of his most notable voice roles include:
• Douma — Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
• Iron Fist / Lin Lie — Marvel Rivals
• Jamie — Street Fighter 6
• Cho Sang-woo — Squid Game
• Naofumi Iwatani — The Rising of the Shield Hero
• Hwei — League of Legends
• Wise — Zenless Zone Zero
• Weather Report — JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean
• Sakuta Azusagawa — Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai
• Anaxa — Honkai: Star Rail
• Lance Crown — Mashle: Magic and Muscles
• Henry Legolant — Black Clover
• Seiji Shishikura — My Hero Academia
• Ryo Saeba — City Hunter
• Noé Archiviste — The Case Study of Vanitas
• Shinpei Ajiro — Summer Time Rendering
• Akito Yamada — My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
• Natsuki Seba — Sakamoto Days
• Naito Mudano — Tougen Anki
• Khrome Ryugu — Beyblade X

With roles spanning intense villains, laid-back leads, fighters, and emotionally complex heroes, Fu continues to make his mark across some of anime and gaming’s biggest worlds.

Happy 41st Birthday, Stephen Fu! 🎂✨

celebrity.quote_zh:
鬼灭之刃、街头霸王、盾牌英雄配音演员傅士芬庆祝 41 岁生日！ 🎙️🔥🎮

史蒂芬·傅 (Stephen Fu) 迅速成为现代动漫和游戏领域的知名人物，将一系列引人注目的英雄、反派和粉丝最爱的角色带入生活。他在《鬼灭之刃》中饰演 Douma 的令人毛骨悚然的表演，与《漫威对手》中的铁拳 / 林烈、《街头霸王 6》中的 Jamie 以及《英雄联盟》中的 Hwei 等主要游戏角色齐名。

动漫迷们还知道他在《盾之勇者成名录》中扮演岩谷尚文、在《JoJo的奇妙冒险：石之海》中扮演天气预报、在《青春猪头少年不会梦到兔女郎学姐》中的梓川咲太以及在《魔法与肌肉》中扮演兰斯·克朗。新角色，如《崩坏：星轨》中的阿那克萨、《坂本时代》中的濑叶夏希以及《桃源 Anki》中的内藤·穆达诺，继续扩大本已令人印象深刻的履历。

他的一些最著名的配音角色包括：
• Douma — 鬼灭之刃：Kimetsu no Yaiba
• 铁拳 / 林烈 — Marvel Rivals
• 杰米 — 街头霸王 6
• Cho Sang-woo — 鱿鱼游戏
• 岩谷尚文 — 《盾之勇者成名录》
• Hwei — 英雄联盟
• Wise — Zenless 零区
• 天气预报 — JoJo的奇妙冒险：石之海
• 梓川咲太 — 青春猪头少年不会梦到兔女郎学姐
• Anaxa — 崩坏：星轨
• Lance Crown — Mashle：魔法与肌肉
• 亨利·莱戈兰特——《黑色四叶草》
• 狮子仓精二 — 我的英雄学院
• Ryo Saeba — 城市猎人
• Noé Archiviste — Vanitas 案例研究
• Shinpei Ajiro — 夏季渲染
• Akito Yamada — 我与山田君的爱情故事 Lv999
• 濑场夏希 — 坂本时代
• 内藤·穆达诺 — Tougen Anki
• Khrome Ryugu — Beyblade X

傅的角色涵盖激烈的反派、悠闲的主角、战士和情感复杂的英雄，他继续在动漫和游戏的一些最大的世界中留下自己的印记。

傅士芬 41 岁生日快乐！ 🎂✨

的令人毛骨悚然的表演，与《漫威对手》中的铁拳 / 林烈、《街头霸王 6》中的 Jamie 以及《英雄联盟》中的 Hwei 等主要游戏角色齐名。

动漫迷们还知道他在《盾之勇者成名录》中扮演岩谷尚文、在《JoJo的奇妙冒险：石之海》中扮演天气预报、在《青春猪头少年不会梦到兔女郎学姐》中的梓川咲太以及在《魔法与肌肉》中扮演兰斯·克朗。新角色，如《崩坏：星轨》中的阿那克萨、《坂本时代》中的濑叶夏希以及《桃源 Anki》中的内藤·穆达诺，继续扩大本已令人印象深刻的履历。

他的一些最著名的配音角色包括：
• Douma — 鬼灭之刃：Kimetsu no Yaiba
• 铁拳 / 林烈 — Marvel Rivals
• 杰米 — 街头霸王 6
• Cho Sang-woo — 鱿鱼游戏
• 岩谷尚文 — 《盾之勇者成名录》
• Hwei — 英雄联盟
• Wise — Zenless 零区
• 天气预报 — JoJo的奇妙冒险：石之海
• 梓川咲太 — 青春猪头少年不会梦到兔女郎学姐
• Anaxa — 崩坏：星轨
• Lance Crown — Mashle：魔法与肌肉
• 亨利·莱戈兰特——《黑色四叶草》
• 狮子仓精二 — 我的英雄学院
• Ryo Saeba — 城市猎人
• Noé Archiviste — Vanitas 案例研究
• Shinpei Ajiro — 夏季渲染
• Akito Yamada — 我与山田君的爱情故事 Lv999
• 濑场夏希 — 坂本时代
• 内藤·穆达诺 — Tougen Anki
• Khrome Ryugu — Beyblade X

傅的角色涵盖激烈的反派、悠闲的主角、战士和情感复杂的英雄，他继续在动漫和游戏的一些最大的世界中留下自己的印记。

celebrity.summary_zh: 商汤科技发布SenseNova U1.6多模态模型，通过原生集成ComfyUI实现图像生成的自我文本校正与4K高保真渲染能力。
celebrity.summary_en: SenseTime has launched SenseNova U1.6, based on the Neo-unify architecture, featuring enhanced natural language instruction parsing and visual structure mapping. The model integrates natively with ComfyUI, enabling self-correction of generated image text and delivering improved 4K rendering fidelity.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 商汤科技正式推出SenseNova U1.6模型，该版本基于Neo-unify架构，核心突破在于增强了模型对复杂自然语言指令的解析与视觉结构映射能力。该模型通过ComfyUI工作流实现了图像生成过程中的文本自检与纠错功能，显著提升了密集文本渲染的准确度及4K画质表现。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: SenseTime has launched SenseNova U1.6, based on the Neo-unify architecture, featuring enhanced natural language instruction parsing and visual structure mapping. The model integrates natively with ComfyUI, enabling self-correction of generated image text and delivering improved 4K rendering fidelity.

elements_zh.where: ComfyUI生态系统
elements_zh.what: 发布SenseNova U1.6模型，引入原生自我校正机制与4K分辨率优化
elements_zh.why: 解决图像生成中文字拼写错误及复杂指令遵循能力不足的行业痛点

elements_en.what: Released SenseNova U1.6 with native self-correction and 4K optimization
elements_en.why: Addressing industry-wide challenges in text rendering accuracy and complex prompt adherence

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 模型将“自我修正”机制前置到推理环节，标志着多模态生成正从“概率性出图”向“确定性控制”演进。此举通过ComfyUI原生插件化策略，极大降低了开发者实现高精度复杂视觉任务的工程门槛，将对现有的Midjourney等闭源方案形成高效的生产力替代竞争。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Moving the 'self-correction' mechanism into the inference loop signifies a shift from probabilistic generation to deterministic control in multimodal AI. By leveraging native ComfyUI integration, SenseTime lowers the engineering barrier for complex visual tasks, challenging incumbent closed-source solutions with superior production utility.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 商汤科技正式推出SenseNova U1.6模型，该版本基于Neo-unify架构，核心突破在于增强了模型对复杂自然语言指令的解析与视觉结构映射能力。该模型通过ComfyUI工作流实现了图像生成过程中的文本自检与纠错功能，显著提升了密集文本渲染的准确度及4K画质表现。
ai_analysis.digest_en: SenseTime has launched SenseNova U1.6, based on the Neo-unify architecture, featuring enhanced natural language instruction parsing and visual structure mapping. The model integrates natively with ComfyUI, enabling self-correction of generated image text and delivering improved 4K rendering fidelity.
key_points_zh: 引入Neo-unify架构实现多模态任务原生统一
支持图像内文字生成后的自动对比与自我修正
ComfyUI原生适配，提供4K高精渲染及增强版提示词遵循能力
key_points_en: Neo-unify architecture for unified multimodal task execution
Automatic comparison and self-correction of text generated within images
Native ComfyUI support for 4K rendering and enhanced prompt following
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 模型将“自我修正”机制前置到推理环节，标志着多模态生成正从“概率性出图”向“确定性控制”演进。此举通过ComfyUI原生插件化策略，极大降低了开发者实现高精度复杂视觉任务的工程门槛，将对现有的Midjourney等闭源方案形成高效的生产力替代竞争。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Moving the 'self-correction' mechanism into the inference loop signifies a shift from probabilistic generation to deterministic control in multimodal AI. By leveraging native ComfyUI integration, SenseTime lowers the engineering barrier for complex visual tasks, challenging incumbent closed-source solutions with superior production utility.
